hero.text: A place where climbing becomes the tool to develop trust, consistency, cooperation and leadership. No age or experience required. We guide you.

photos.kidsAlt: Coach and child at the climbing gym

about.title: Three pieces of a puzzle
about.p1: We're a British, a French and a Spanish — which sounds like a joke, but we fit perfectly. Together with our coaches and setters we do something AI can't: it comes from within.
about.p2: For nearly 10 years we've been guiding children and adults through value-based development — using climbing as the tool, indoors and in nature.

team.name: + Monitors & Setters
team.role: The team that brings the space to life daily

activities.title: Inside and outside
activities.sub: Whether you're a beginner or experienced, we have something for you.

kallpa.title: Espai Kallpa
kallpa.text: A space created by and for women. Kallpa means "strength" in Quechua. Your place to find your strength, your community and your climbing.

items.q: How much is a day pass?

a.p: A day pass at our climbing gym costs €10, whatever time you come.

items.q: At what age can you start climbing?

a.p: We have classes from age 3: we call it Baby Climbing, and it's on Saturdays.

From age 5 we have classes every day. From 17:00 to 18:00 there are classes for ages 5 to 9, in different groups with a maximum of 8 kids per class. And from 18:00 to 19:00 we offer classes for ages 10 to 16.
If you've never climbed before, there are two options:

ol: Beginner course: Mondays from 19:30 to 20:30, made up of 4 classes, one each Monday. A new one usually starts every month, and it costs €55, gear included.
Book a beginner class: €45 for one person, or €30 per person if there are more of you.

items.q: Do you have climbing training groups?

a.p: Yes, we run group climbing training. Sessions last an hour and a half. Times: Mondays at 20:00, and Tuesdays and Thursdays at 19:00 and 20:00.
€47 per month, or €130 if you pay per quarter.
It's a women-only space, on Wednesdays from 19:00 to 21:00. It costs €10, the same as a day pass, and €2 goes to the Girl Power project of the association Climb for Human Rights.

booking.title: Ready to start?
booking.text: Write to us directly on WhatsApp. We'll reply and guide you towards the activity that best suits you or your child.
steps: Send us a WhatsApp telling us who you are and what interests you.
We reply and guide you towards the ideal activity for you.
We confirm your spot and see you at the gym!
